newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wool indicator jumps 28c to 612c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wool indicator jumps 28c to 612c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator jumped 28 cents to 612 cents a kg clean on Wednesday in Sydney and Geelong, Wool International (WI) said.
All merino fleece prices were dearer, with the 19 and 20 micron indicators up 6.5 percent.
The 21m category was 5.5 percent dearer, 22m was 5.0 percent dearer, 23m 4.5 percent dearer and 24m up to 4.0 percent dearer. The 25m category was 3.0 percent dearer and 26m was 1.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were dearer, with 19m up 4.0 percent and 20/21m up 3.0 percent.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were 1.0 percent dearer and 29/30/31m 1.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were 2.5 percent dearer, locks up to 2.0 percent dearer and crutchings 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
WI said Japan and China were principal buyers with support from Taiwan, Western Europe and most sectors of the trade.
Of the 26,113 bales offered, 3.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Geelong with about 28,700 bales to be offered.
